Name: Ferngill Simple Economy for Vintage Interface V2
Author: MrKarolix
Description:
Replaces the Ferngill Simple Economy stock menu button to match the theme of the inventory for Vintage Interface V2.

This mod requires ---> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21414]Ferngill Simple Economy[/url]﻿

To use it replace the Ferngill Simple Economy stock-menu.png asset in the assets folder allow it to overwrite and that's it.

Downloads.Description: Replace the assets in Ferngill Simple Economy
